correctness.rationale: The proof derives the exact two-state integer recurrence, demonstrates all primitive residue pairs and primitive test rows are reachable via positive coprime lifts and the Euclidean algorithm, classifies Myhill–Nerode residuals for affine target 1 and homogeneous target 0, and counts the free unit-group quotient by CRT and totients. An independently implemented state-space minimizer checked each modulus 2–31; direct exhaustive subsequence-set counts agreed for all 8191 words through length twelve. The infinite claim depends on the proof, not finite experiments.

value.rationale: Counts of distinct subsequences are a natural streaming text statistic. The theorem gives the precise minimum deterministic memory for two intrinsically distinguished modular predicates (zero total vs minus-one total), a complete structural classification of their right quotients, and an unbounded \(\varphi(m)\)-factor separation. This is a global all-modulus classification and not a finite table or arbitrary special case.
